## 页面标题
- **Key assessments AIRTIVITY vs OLE trial comparison**

## 表格（可见内容逐项转写）
表头：**Category | AIRTIVITY | OLE**

### Safety
- AIRTIVITY：Adverse events reporting incl. PEx review - PEx adjudication  
- OLE：Adverse events reporting incl. PEX rew w **— no adjudication**
- AIRTIVITY：Physical exam, height, BW, Tanner stage  
- OLE：Physical exam, height, BW, Tanner stage
- AIRTIVITY：Safety lab  
- OLE：Safety lab

### PFT
- AIRTIVITY：PFT (LCI)  
- OLE：PFT (LCI)

### PROs
- AIRTIVITY：PROs: BEST, QoL-B, CAAT, abbrev. SNOT-22, cough severity NRS (SGRQ at baseline)  
- OLE：x、x（两处“x”标记）

### Biomarkers
- AIRTIVITY：Sputum: biomarkers, Murray sputum color chart, P.aeruginosa  
- OLE：x、x（两处“x”标记）
- AIRTIVITY：Blood biomarker samples  
- OLE：x

### HRCT Sub study
- AIRTIVITY：Substudies: cough and sputum, HRCT  
- OLE：Substudies: follow up HRCT

### PK
- AIRTIVITY：PK blood samples  
- OLE：x
